preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the binary string S must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must only contain characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of different equivalence classes of the substrings of S.
